name: clef-guard
description: Has Cloudflare's Clef decision model rate each Bash command's risk, and asks you before running one it finds risky.

accountId.title: Cloudflare Account ID
accountId.description: The account whose Workers AI runs Clef. Falls back to the CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID environment variable.

apiToken.title: Cloudflare API Token
apiToken.description: A token with Workers AI read permission, kept in secure storage. Falls back to the CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN environment variable.

model.title: Clef model
model.description: clef (27B, more accurate) or clef-flash (9B, faster and cheaper).

threshold.title: Ask threshold
threshold.description: Ask before running a command when Clef puts its chance of being hard to undo or destructive at or above this (0 to 1).
